common_response.successes: number of sampled non-skipped stops with >=2 distinct species having CallingIndex in {'1','2','3'}

temperature_secondary.eligibility: primary-eligible run with >=8 sampled stops having numeric AirTemp and TempScale in {'C','F'}
temperature_secondary.run_summary: arithmetic mean AirTemp_C across eligible sampled stops
temperature_secondary.formula: prop ~ rain_z + temp_z + C(State) + C(RunNumber) + C(RouteType) + year_z
temperature_secondary.support_rule: beta_temp > 0 and two-sided cluster-robust p < 0.05 and 95% CI excludes 0
temperature_secondary.sensitivity: complete 10-stop primary runs with >=8 valid temperature stops

seasonal_shoulder_secondary.state_last_window_rule: within each State among 2001-2015 UnifiedProtocol==1 runs, last_window=max numeric RunNumber; states with last_window not in {3,4} are excluded
seasonal_shoulder_secondary.shoulder_rule: shoulder=1 when RunNumber==1 or RunNumber==state_last_window; otherwise 0
seasonal_shoulder_secondary.formula: prop ~ rain_z + rain_z:shoulder + C(State) + C(RunNumber) + C(RouteType) + year_z
seasonal_shoulder_secondary.biological_interpretation: recent rainfall is more strongly associated with multi-species chorus synchrony in the first/last state-specific sampling windows than in middle windows
seasonal_shoulder_secondary.support_rule: beta_rain_x_shoulder < 0 and two-sided cluster-robust p < 0.05 and 95% CI excludes 0
seasonal_shoulder_secondary.sensitivity: restrict to states whose observed last_window is 4
